test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Enormous
solution:
The correct answer is: Large.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Enormous"** means very large in size, quantity, or extent. (विशाल)

 
 
• **Example:** The **enormous **elephant towered over the other animals in the safari park.
 
 
 
• **"Large"** refers to something that is of considerable or relatively great size, extent, or capacity. (बड़ा)
 
 
• **Example:** She lives in a **large **house with a beautiful garden.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Enormous'** is **'Large'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Little** (थोड़ा): Small in size, amount, or degree.

 
 
• **Example:** The **little **puppy looked so adorable as it played in the yard.
 
 
 
• **Tiny** (सूक्ष्म): Very small in size.
 
 
• **Example:** The **tiny **ant carried a large crumb back to its nest.
 
 
 
• **Small** (छोटा): Of a size that is less than normal or usual.
 
 
• **Example:** He gave a **small **gift to his friend as a token of appreciation.
